name: Libram of Resilience
objectiveText: Progress If it is resilience you desire, thirty gold I require. Black Diamond  ( 1 ) Crystal Spire  ( 4 ) Burning Essence  ( 1 ) Libram of Resilience  ( 1 )   Required money: 30  ( 1 )

comments.body:
If you are level 70 you can do this solo even without stealth.  Helps to be a mage to blink past a few "tight spots".

Enter BRD, go through the locked door on your left, continue straight to the "highway", take a right and follow the hall to Incendius, melt his face, loot corpse, dance happy jig, disenchant BOP drop (if you can), continue straight and go up the ramp, avoid mobs by walking on the railing most fo the way.  At the top fo the ramp go through the doorway and go to the left, take the next left into the Cofffer Room.  Blink past the boss and the dog so you are standing against the Dark Coffer.  Attack and kill the dog and ignore the boss until the dog is dead.  At level 70 you should resist all or most of the bosses spells.  Kill the boss, loot and dance again, DE, walk to the edge of the room (stand about where the boss was standing), adjust your camera angle so you can click the picture on the wall and read the caption n the picture to find where the NPC is that you need to kill to get the Dark Coffer Key.  Backtrack to wherever that mobs is and kill him to get the key, then return to the Coffer Room, open the Dark Coffer, loot contents, hearth out to Orgrimmar or Ironforge... spam the trade channel til you sell the "enchant" or get ignored by everyone on your server.

If you happen to get ignored by everyone on the server, pay Blizzard to do a server transfer to another.  Repeat as needed.

:-P
This CAN be enchanted through the trade window. Rogues and Druids can stealth run the BRD coffer for the Burning Essence, and give it to anyone once they turn in the quest for the arcanum.

To get the main (and hardest to get) ingredient, the Burning Essence, you first need to examine the Portrait on the wall outside the Coffer Room. By doing so, you then get the name of the Dark Key Holder. (1 of 6 possibles). Once you do so, and have the name, you have to kill him, and then reurn with the key to open the Dark Coffer. The list of Dark Key holders and where they can be found are:
Dark Keeper Offgut		West Garrison - room with Angerforge		
Dark Keeper Bethek		Patrols near Coffer room
Dark Keeper Vorfalk		Grim Guzzler Tavern 			
Dark Keeper Zimrel		Arena; upper seating area
Dark Keeper Uggel		Top of ramp in Golem Room w/Fineous		
Dark Keeper Pelver		Domicile room (storeroom in center)

All but 2 are fairly easy to do. 
Bethek spawns almost instantly outside the Coffer room, so be prepared. 
Vorfalk is surrounded by patrons in the Grim Guzzler. To get to him, you have to pull the patrons around him, 1 by 1, with the Dark Iron Ale.
Just make sure you kill the patron before they drink it, as it's limited in supply.
After all that, the Burning Essence is still a 50% drop, so you may need a few attempts before you get it. I still feel the drop is Quest related, so make sure you have the Libram of Resilience on you, and that you have already spoken with Mathredis Firestar in Burning Steppes, and that regardless of who gets the Dark Key, you open the chest. After weeks of trying and failing, I wasn't taking any chances. It is worth the effort!
And yes, it is BOP, and can't be split up; though, you'll want the extra one anyway! An extra +40 FR  can make a big difference in MC.

There are a number of other books found around the world. They are "lost texts" of the Quel'Thalas High Elves? There are two NPCs that "collect" these when you find them. 

One NPC, [url=/npc=9836]Mathredis Firestar[/url], is found in Flame Crest in The Burning Steppes. 
He only accepts Librams of [url=/quest=4481]Constitution[/url] (100HP), [url=/quest=4483]Resilience[/url] (20FR), [url=/quest=4463]Rumination[/url] (100mana), [url=/quest=4482]Tenacity[/url] (125armor), and [url=/quest=4484]Voracity[/url] (+8 to any stat).
